definitions.gloss: going to work; attendance at work
definitions.explanation: going to work; attendance at work

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}8{時|じ}に{出勤|しゅっきん}する。
examples.english: I go to work at 8 every morning.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{出勤|しゅっきん}{日|び}ですか？
{電車|でんしゃ}が{遅|おく}れて{出勤|しゅっきん}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった。
examples.english: The train was delayed and I couldn't make it to work on time.

notes:
{出勤|しゅっきん} means going to work or reporting for duty. As a suru-verb, it means "to go to work", "to report for work".

Common compounds:
- {出勤|しゅっきん}{時間|じかん} (time of going to work)
- {出勤|しゅっきん}{日|び} (workday)
- {出勤|しゅっきん}ラッシュ (rush hour for commuting to work)
- {時差|じさ}{出勤|しゅっきん} (staggered working hours)

Antonym: {退勤|たいきん} (leaving work)

Related terms:
- {通勤|つうきん} (commuting)
- {欠勤|けっきん} (absence from work)
